items.title: The Laplace's Demon
items.reason: A research team builds a system for predicting seemingly random events, then becomes trapped inside a deadly test of the very model they created — strong scientist, rule-discovery and escalating-system DNA.

items.title: The Incident
items.reason: Two groups are trapped in impossible repeating spaces — an endless staircase and an endless road — making the central hook the discovery of how an artificial-feeling reality system works.

items.title: Altered States
items.reason: A psycho-physiologist experiments on himself with sensory deprivation and drugs, producing increasingly bizarre changes tied to consciousness and possible genetic memory; horror elements are present, but the science experiment stays central.

items.title: Parallel
items.reason: Friends discover a mirror into parallel realities and begin exploiting information from the other side, with the premise continually generating new consequences rather than becoming a simple escape story.

items.title: The Arrival
items.reason: A radio astronomer detects evidence of intelligent alien life and follows the anomaly into a larger scientific conspiracy, keeping investigation and the need to understand the phenomenon at the center.

items.title: Debris
items.reason: Two agents investigate fragments of an alien spacecraft that cause a different bizarre phenomenon wherever they appear — genetic anomalies, reality changes and secret organizations make this exceptionally close to the Fringe formula.

items.title: Threshold
items.reason: A secret team of specialists investigates an extraterrestrial encounter, alien signals, DNA alteration and spreading biological effects — scientists actively testing an escalating unknown phenomenon rather than merely fighting it.

items.title: 3 Body Problem
items.reason: Scientists confront apparently impossible events and evidence that fundamental physics may be breaking down, with the mystery expanding into a much larger extraterrestrial problem rather than a conventional space-opera story.
